command_result.command: cd /app; cat docs/refactoring.md docs/settings.md; find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | head -100; wc -l quoter/*.py tests/*.py

cd /app; git status 2>&1 | head -3; for f in quoter/settings.py quoter/cli.py quoter/__init__.py quoter/__main__.py quoter/core/*.py quoter/services/*.py quoter/commands/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app; cp -r /app /tmp/orig; cat quoter/cli.py | sed -n 40,100p; for f in quoter/core/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app; for f in quoter/__init__.py quoter/__main__.py quoter/services/cache.py quoter/services/batch.py quoter/services/quotes.py quoter/output/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app; for f in quoter/carriers/*.py quoter/geo/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app; for f in quoter/output/csvout.py quoter/packing/*.py quoter/pricing/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done

cd /tmp/orig; python -m quoter --width 30 carriers; echo ---; python -m quoter --width 30 quote --from DE-10115 --to FR-75001 --weight 2 --format label; python -m quoter --width 30 quote --from DE-10115 --to FR-75001 --weight 2 | head -3; cat samples/customer-1.ini; ls tests; cat tests/helpers.py
cd /app/tests; cat test_settings.py test_quotes.py test_zones.py test_batch.py test_output.py test_cli.py

cd /app/quoter && python - <<'EOF'
def sub(path, old, new):
    s = open(path).read()
    assert s.count(old) == 1, (path, old)
    open(path, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))

sub('pricing/fuel.py', '''def fuel_charge(amount: Decimal, carrier)''', '''def fuel_charge(conf, amount: Decimal, carrier)''')
sub('pricing/fuel.py', 'carrier.fuel_factor - 1', 'carrier.fuel_factor(conf) - 1')

p='pricing/tax.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter.settings import SETTINGS\n', '')
sub(p, 'def rate_for(dest: str)', 'def rate_for(conf, dest: str)')
sub(p, 'return SETTINGS.tax_rate', 'return conf.tax_rate')
sub(p, '''def apply_tax(amount: Decimal, rate: Decimal = SETTINGS.tax_rate) -> Decimal:
    """Amount including tax at `rate`, rounded to cents."""
''', '''def apply_tax(conf, amount: Decimal, rate: Decimal | None = None) -> Decimal:
    """Amount including tax at `rate` (the `tax_rate` setting when not given),
    rounded to cents."""
    if rate is None:
        rate = conf.tax_rate
''')

p='pricing/rates.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter import settings\n\n', '')
sub(p, '''def band_price(zone: int, kg: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    card_name = settings.SETTINGS.rate_card''', '''def band_price(conf, zone: int, kg: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    card_name = conf.rate_card''')

p='pricing/insurance.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter.settings import current\n', '')
sub(p, 'def premium(declared', 'def premium(conf, declared')
sub(p, '    conf = current()\n', '')

p='pricing/discounts.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter import settings\n', '')
sub(p, 'def discount_pct(shipments', 'def discount_pct(conf, shipments')
sub(p, 'settings.SETTINGS.discount_tiers', 'conf.discount_tiers')

p='pricing/fx.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter import settings\n\n', '')
sub(p, '''_FACTORS: dict = {}


def factor(currency: str)''', '''def factor(conf, currency: str)''')
sub(p, '''    if currency not in _FACTORS:
        if currency == "EUR":
            _FACTORS[currency] = Decimal(1)
        else:
            _FACTORS[currency] = REFERENCE[currency] * (1 + settings.SETTINGS.fx_margin / 100)
    return _FACTORS[currency]
''', '''    if currency == "EUR":
        return Decimal(1)
    return REFERENCE[currency] * (1 + conf.fx_margin / 100)
''')
sub(p, '''def convert(amount_eur: Decimal, currency: str | None = None) -> Decimal:
    code = currency or settings.SETTINGS.currency
    return amount_eur * factor(code)''', '''def convert(conf, amount_eur: Decimal, currency: str | None = None) -> Decimal:
    code = currency or conf.currency
    return amount_eur * factor(conf, code)''')

p='pricing/surcharges.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter import settings\n', '')
sub(p, '''def amount(kind: str) -> Decimal:
    """The configured amount of a surcharge kind."""
    return getattr(settings.SETTINGS, "surcharge_" + kind)''', '''def amount(conf, kind: str) -> Decimal:
    """The configured amount of a surcharge kind."""
    return getattr(conf, "surcharge_" + kind)''')
sub(p, 'def applicable(request,', 'def applicable(conf, request,')
sub(p, 'if timeutil.in_peak(timeutil.pricing_date()) and amount("peak") > 0:', 'if timeutil.in_peak(timeutil.pricing_date(conf)) and amount(conf, "peak") > 0:')
sub(p, '''def total(kinds: list) -> Decimal:
    return sum((amount(k) for k in kinds), Decimal(0))''', '''def total(conf, kinds: list) -> Decimal:
    return sum((amount(conf, k) for k in kinds), Decimal(0))''')

p='packing/dims.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter.settings import SETTINGS\n\nDIM_DIVISOR = SETTINGS.dim_divisor\n\n', '')
sub(p, '''def volumetric_kg(dims: tuple) -> Decimal:
    length, width, height = dims
    return length * width * height / DIM_DIVISOR''', '''def volumetric_kg(conf, dims: tuple) -> Decimal:
    length, width, height = dims
    return length * width * height / conf.dim_divisor''')
sub(p, 'def chargeable_kg(actual_kg', 'def chargeable_kg(conf, actual_kg')
sub(p, 'max(kg, volumetric_kg(dims))', 'max(kg, volumetric_kg(conf, dims))')

p='packing/boxes.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter import settings\n\n\n', '\n')
sub(p, '''def catalogue() -> tuple:
    return BOX_SETS[settings.SETTINGS.box_set]''', '''def catalogue(conf) -> tuple:
    return BOX_SETS[conf.box_set]''')

p='packing/packer.py'
sub(p, 'from quoter import settings\n', '')
sub(p, 'def choose_box(item_dims', 'def choose_box(conf, item_dims')
sub(p, 'settings.SETTINGS.packing_margin_cm', 'conf.packing_margin_cm')
sub(p, 'boxes.catalogue()', 'boxes.catalogue(conf)')
EOF
head -12 packing/boxes.py pricing/rates.py
cd /app/quoter && grep -c conf services/quotes.py services/batch.py services/cache.py; grep -n fields services/cache.py
python /tmp/edit2.py && cd /app/quoter && grep -n 'format_money' output/*.py | head -30; sed -n 1,12p output/render.py
python /tmp/edit3.py && cd /app && grep -rnE 'SETTINGS|current\(|configure|reset\(|import settings|_settings|CONF\b' quoter | grep -v '^quoter/settings.py'
python /tmp/edit4.py; cd /app/tests; grep -n 'conf\|settings' test_quotes.py test_zones.py test_batch.py test_output.py | head -80
python /tmp/edit5.py; cd /app && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30
